definitions.explanation: Competitive gymnastics performed on apparatus such as the vault, parallel bars, rings, horizontal bar, balance beam, and uneven bars. Distinguished from rhythmic gymnastics ({新体操|しんたいそう}) and general floor-based exercise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{器械体操|きかいたいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}っている→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: My daughter is learning artistic gymnastics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{器械体操|きかいたいそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出場|しゅつじょう}した→出場する：20348_shutsujousuru⟧。
examples.english: He competed in the Olympics as an artistic gymnast.

examples.japanese: {器械体操|きかいたいそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鉄棒|てつぼう}→鉄棒：17912_tetsubou⟧や{平行棒|へいこうぼう}⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種目|しゅもく}→種目：27734_shumoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Artistic gymnastics has events such as the horizontal bar and parallel bars.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{器械|きかい}→器械：17728_kikai⟧ (apparatus) + ⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧ (gymnastics, exercise). Refers to the form of gymnastics seen at the Olympics, performed on six (men's) or four (women's) pieces of apparatus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {器械体操|きかいたいそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧: artistic gymnast
- {器械体操|きかいたいそう}{部|ぶ}: gymnastics club
- {器械体操|きかいたいそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧: gymnastics competition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新体操|しんたいそう}→新体操：22205_shintaisou⟧: rhythmic gymnastics — uses ribbon, ball, hoop, rope, or clubs
- ⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧: gymnastics, calisthenics — general term, includes everyday exercise
- {床運動|ゆかうんどう}: floor exercise — one event within artistic gymnastics
